validation.interpretation: Each selected task ran once through the existing runner in one of four isolated worktrees. Registry dependency/resource/exclusive hints were checked before splitting. These manually combined development checks are not a release seal or reusable seal checkpoints.

attempts.reason: Initial harness imported the contract from the root dependency scope, where it is not installed. No comparison cases ran. The repository contract path fixed setup; all sixteen comparisons passed.

performance.interpretation: Two serial before/after PS-08 pairs passed the unchanged comparator. All six artifact hashes match in all four campaigns. The initial schema build-time increase reversed in the repeat. Small descriptive observations, not a performance gate or a claim of significance.
performance.layout: Reconstruct each original report by combining shared fields, run fields excluding id/cells, and ordered cells formed from fixture identities plus run cells. Every original field, sample and statistic is retained.

dependencies.workspacePreparation: lockfile install with scripts disabled; pnpm build required before run

cache.warm: same process after warmup; fresh request lifecycle

timing.buildMs: CLI imports, project resolution and buildProject; excludes fixture setup and worker startup
timing.coldLoadMs: artifact reads and runtime imports; JavaScript application/codecs import; Native instantiation occurs in requests
timing.firstRequestMs: first complete provider-host request including request construction/body materialization, Native validation/compilation/instantiation and mandatory request disposal
timing.warmRequestMs: same complete request after warmup, including request construction, body materialization and mandatory disposal; correctness assertions outside timer
timing.cleanupMs: delete per-cell project and build outputs after all samples; excluded from build/load/request
timing.compilerPeakRssBytes: maximum individual ASC process resourceUsage.maxRSS, including its source-map re-exec; never summed; Native only; JavaScript compiler/build worker high-water RSS (includes imports/writer)
timing.artifactBytes: Native executable Wasm; JavaScript emitted executable .js/.cjs modules and schema codecs; dependencies/inspection excluded

protocol.request: fixtures.cases[0]; in-memory Node provider fixture fetch, no network or HTTP server
protocol.runtime: workspace Node provider host, generated JavaScript source package / canonical Native Wasm
protocol.instrumentation: test-owned spawnSync wrapper preloads resourceUsage exit recorder into ASC; no production source hooks
